offlineOnlyBuild.description: Default Android build when VITE_API_BASE_URL is NOT set (uses on-device Android TTS + local Offline Tone Coach).
notes: All study progress, starred phrases, custom phrases, and settings stay strictly in local device storage.
Offline Tone Coach processes microphone audio strictly in volatile on-device memory and never transmits it off the device.
Optional Android system Speech Recognition invokes Android's OS-provided speech service only when explicitly chosen by the user.
Zero ads, zero Google Advertising ID, zero third-party analytics SDKs, zero accounts.

withHostedRegionalTtsBackend.description: Use these answers if you set VITE_API_BASE_URL to your hosted Nói Express TTS server at build time.
